verdict.rationale: Salesmate's own docs say it manages deals and pipelines, which covers the core of pipeline tracking. The specific elements of the story are not documented. missing for 10: evidence of a visual/kanban pipeline view, customizable pipeline stages, drag-and-drop deal updates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates

citations.quote: Manage contacts, companies, deals, pipelines, activities, and conversations in one place.
